description: Deterministic work bounds of zone interest and tick operations (#138) and of Greyhaven client presentation (#645); counters come from mmorpg-core and mmorpg-presentation, never wall-clock time.

scenarios.description: Camera-only frames orbiting a standing viewer at the Greyhaven hub
One viewer with a fixed local neighbourhood in a zone of 512 players

operations.description: Project one viewer's visible snapshot: candidate work follows its local neighbourhood, not the zone population.

local.description: players inside the viewer's interest neighbourhood

operations.description: Publish every player's snapshot in a sparse zone: total candidate work is linear in recipients at a fixed local density.

recipients.description: players receiving a snapshot, spread at a fixed density

operations.description: Publish every player's snapshot when everyone stands in one hub: each recipient's candidates grow with the crowd, honestly quadratic in total.

recipients.description: players crowded within one interest radius

operations.description: Advance one tick: interest index writes follow the units that change cells, never a rebuild, whatever the stationary population.

moved.description: players crossing an interest cell boundary this tick

metrics.name: units_inspected
metrics.notes: Maintenance re-reads every body position once per tick; it must stay linear, not rebuild.

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): camera-only frames around a standing viewer over settled static residency build, upload and evict no static scenery, whatever the authored scenery.

frames.description: measured frames after residency settles and one warm-up lap

orbit_metres.description: camera orbit radius around the viewer, metres

metrics.name: static_builds
metrics.notes: Static groups and near terrain tiles built (the complete static world is 4,169 groups and 96 tiles).

metrics.name: largest_frame_draws
metrics.notes: Static draw records one frame selects before renderer batching; nothing is hidden to shrink it.

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): walking east from the hub enters and leaves terrain tiles and group reaches; streaming builds stay within the per-frame budget.

metres.description: metres walked at a running pace (0.1 m per frame)

operations.description: Greyhaven client presentation (#645): one frame of the shared unit presenter over a wolf crowd with one moving wolf; draws follow the animated characters, geometry uploads do not.

characters.description: wolves added around the viewer (animated characters A)

metrics.name: geometry_uploads
metrics.notes: New unit geometries over 64 frames after a warm-up frame; breathing animal torsos still add one per family and frame (advisory).
